title: OutRun 2006: Coast 2 Coast
description: Sumo Digital's OutRun2 port for the original Xbox — the game our Xbox oracle drives from cold boot into the race. So far the Studio carries the /Cars roster: the player's Dino 246 GTS and the fifteen AI rivals, each decompressed from its .sz container, decoded from the _pmt mesh format with its XPR0 textures, and rebuilt as a textured GLB.
